data.label: A Company of Heroes: Ready for Adventure!
data.description: Each group member plays a specific role: the Valiant Knight leads charges and protects allies; the Heartthrob Thief gathers items and info, weakens enemies, and strikes with abandon; the Naïve Chosen heals and supports allies; the Young Sage is a keen observer who knows mighty elemental spells.
